title: Research DAG store event
description: One event file in a shared DAG store, <store>/<project>/events/YYYY-MM-DD/<eid>.json. Archive files hold the same events, one per line, with src added.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Replay orders by ts, then src.

src.description: Archive lines only: the path the event had under the project folder.

fields.description: Top-level keys other than nodes, to their values.

comments.description: Top-level key to the comment block above it.

node.description: The whole node, fields in order.

comment.description: The comment block above the node.

set.description: Field to its new value. The latest set of a field wins.

prev.description: Field to the value the writer saw. A different value in place means a concurrent edit, which is reported.

values.description: Items appended to the list field, skipping ones already there.

id.description: The id the node goes by.

was.description: The id it was added as, which a concurrent writer took first.

target.description: The eid of the add event.
